contract: construct(n) -> array of shape (n, 3): rows (x, y, deg) placing n copies of the fixed Christmas-tree polygon without overlap (deg rotates about the tree origin, x and y within [-100, 100]); called once for every n from n_min to n_max
notes: The reference value is the competition's getting-started sample submission scored with the official metric; the seed grid scores 162.58.

Independent implementation of the Kaggle Santa 2025 metric (same polygon, 1e18 scaling, touch-but-not-overlap rule, bounding-square area over n summed over n = 1..200); reproduces the official metric's doctest value and the getting-started sample submission's score exactly (validation/santa-2025-crosscheck.json).
protocol_description: Reimplemented in this repository and cross-checked against the paper's published constructions/values.
name: Santa 2025: Christmas tree packing (n = 1..200)
description: For every n from 1 to 200 place n copies of the competition's fixed 15-vertex tree polygon (rotations allowed, no overlaps, coordinates within [-100, 100]) so that the bounding square of each configuration is as small as possible; the score is the sum over n of (bounding-square area / n), lower is better.
benchmark: Kaggle Santa 2025 - Christmas Tree Packing Challenge
paper_metric: sum over n of bounding-square area / n
